before: Prior public video view threshold was based on watching or clicking, now referred to as engaged viewing in the August 2026 explanation; formats may have had differing historical counting rules.
after: Public views count from the first playback frame for Shorts, long-form videos, podcasts and live streams, including autoplay/hover or Shorts feed playback.

measurement_levels.description: A thumbnail shown without initiating playback. Exposure is not a view.
First playback frame, including autoplay, hover playback, clicked video starts, and Shorts starts from Aug 24 2026.
Playback initiated by click/tap or watched beyond the initial seconds, subject to platform counting criteria.
Views that count toward the corresponding YouTube Partner Program threshold, subject to format, public availability and policy exclusions.
Public watch hours eligible toward applicable program requirements, distinct from all minutes watched or raw playback starts.
Creator Analytics ad-serving-related playback count, not a synonym for raw public video views or qualified program views.
Individual ad display; one monetized playback may involve different numbers of ads.
Distinct people estimated within a defined audience and period; cannot be computed directly from view events.

format_applicability.policy_effect: Raw public start counts can include previews and autoplay; channel earnings and program qualification still require their separate measures.
Shorts first-frame starts are counted; creator earnings still require qualified attention and pooled Shorts payout rules.
Public playback start metric standardized, but live watch time, engaged behavior and paid features are separate.
Podcast-designated video playback starts adopt the same public first-frame definition, distinct from playlist reach and unique listeners.

api_revision.current_definition: Video playback starts, including hover-to-play, autoplay and click-to-play starts.

valid_reuse: Snapshots entirely within the post-2026-08-24 public-view definition, with compatible scope and sampling.
Engaged-to-engaged measures with the same reporting conditions and definitions, subject to source validation.
Within-period comparisons of qualified watch hours for a single program-eligible cohort, with applicable exclusions documented.
invalid_reuse: Treat a rise in raw public views across Aug 24 as observed growth in active watching.
Divide post-change public video views by pre-change public views and call it retention gain.
Use raw public views to establish YPP qualification or monetization eligibility.
Use an engaged-views result to estimate unique humans without deduplication.
Compute revenue per public playback start by reusing an engaged-views RPM denominator.
Assume the view-count revision changed the underlying recommendation system or payments by the same percentage.
Infer a universal engaged/public ratio or causal traffic multiplier from YouTube's policy update.

reported_unaffected: Core metrics including click-through rate, average view duration and retention remain anchored on engaged viewing under the official explanation.
Recommendations and partner-program qualification rules were not directly revised by this public count redefinition.
research_application: Use metric-consistent cohorts to investigate topics, creator supply and revenue. Mark series crossing August 2026 with an explicit break and either stratify or seek a legitimate reprocessed comparable series.
limits: YouTube has not publicly provided a general conversion between pre-August and post-August raw public view counts.
Platform rules distinguish engaged attention from fully qualified Partner Program thresholds; do not equate them automatically.
A browser page view, thumbnail impression, initiated video and unique human are separate quantities.
